name: Sniper Assassin 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Assassin 3 is a free sniper game. Put your skills to the test in this game puzzle game, and help elite sniper Shawn Davidson get the revenge he so desperately wants in this third installment of the Sniper Assassin series. Much like the previous games, in Sniper Assassin 3, you’re embarking on a series of missions, all of which with a specific target (or targets) that you must discover and take care of. The trick is discovering how to complete each mission. Make the wrong move, and it’s over.
